{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species, using only non-missing flipper_length_mm values
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Identify the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Output the result
highest_mean_species"}
